# FeedBear

FeedBear helps product teams collect, organize, and act on customer feedback, feature requests, comments, and changelog updates.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/feedbear/.

## Actions

- **Add Item Comment**: Publish a public comment on a FeedBear item as the API key creator.
- **Create Board Item**: Create a feedback item on a FeedBear board without notifying users.
- **Delete Board Item**: Permanently delete a FeedBear board item, with explicit force confirmation available for items with merged posts.
- **Get Board Item** (read-only): Get the full details of one feedback item from a FeedBear board.
- **List Board Items** (read-only): List or search feedback items on a FeedBear board, with optional status and sort filters.
- **List Boards** (read-only): List boards in the connected FeedBear project, optionally including private team-only boards.
- **List Changelog Entries** (read-only): List published FeedBear changelog entries newest first.
- **List Item Comments** (read-only): List non-spam comments on a FeedBear item, newest first, including reply relationships.
- **List Statuses** (read-only): List the statuses configured for the connected FeedBear project.
- **Update Board Item**: Update selected fields of an existing FeedBear board item without notifying voters.
